schema:
CREATE TABLE "teams" ("team_code" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, "region_id" INTEGER);
CREATE TABLE "players" ("player_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, "role" TEXT, "team_code" INTEGER, "score" INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY ("team_code") REFERENCES "teams"("team_code"));
correct_query: SELECT DISTINCT TEAM_CODE FROM PLAYERS WHERE SCORE = (SELECT MAX(SCORE) FROM PLAYERS NATURAL JOIN TEAMS WHERE ROLE = 'starter' GROUP BY TEAM_CODE HAVING COUNT(PLAYER_ID) > 2)
